results.sql: SELECT "r"."region_nm" AS "region", ROUND(SUM("l"."price_lcl" * "fx"."rate"), 2) AS "net_revenue_usd" FROM (SELECT "ord_id", "cust_id", "ord_stat_cd", "purch_ts", "appr_ts", "carrier_ts", "dlvr_ts", "est_dlvr_dt", "is_deleted", "src_sys_cd" FROM "sales"."ord_hdr" WHERE (is_deleted = FALSE) AND (cust_id IN (SELECT cust_id FROM crm."CUST_MSTR_V2" WHERE is_current AND cust_state IN (SELECT state_cd FROM ref.region WHERE region_cd IN ('SE'))))) AS "h" JOIN (SELECT "ord_id", "line_no", "prod_id", "seller_id", "ship_lmt_ts", "price_lcl", "frt_lcl", "ccy_cd" FROM "sales"."ord_line" WHERE (ord_id IN (SELECT h.ord_id FROM sales.ord_hdr AS h JOIN crm."CUST_MSTR_V2" AS c ON c.cust_id = h.cust_id AND c.is_current WHERE c.cust_state IN (SELECT state_cd FROM ref.region WHERE region_cd IN ('SE'))))) AS "l" ON "l"."ord_id" = "h"."ord_id" JOIN (SELECT "rate_dt", "from_ccy", "to_ccy", "rate", "is_filled" FROM "finance"."fx_rate_daily") AS "fx" ON "fx"."rate_dt" = CAST("h"."purch_ts" AS DATE) JOIN (SELECT "cust_sk", "cust_id", "cust_uid", "cust_zip5", "cust_city", "cust_state", "valid_from", "valid_to", "is_current" FROM "crm"."cust_mstr_v2" WHERE (cust_state IN (SELECT state_cd FROM ref.region WHERE region_cd IN ('SE')))) AS "c" ON "c"."cust_id" = "h"."cust_id" AND "c"."is_current" JOIN (SELECT "state_cd", "state_nm", "region_cd", "region_nm" FROM "ref"."region") AS "r" ON "r"."state_cd" = "c"."cust_state" WHERE NOT "h"."is_deleted" AND NOT "h"."ord_stat_cd" IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND "r"."region_cd" = 'SE' AND "h"."purch_ts" >= CAST('2017-04-01' AS TIMESTAMP) AND "h"."purch_ts" < CAST('2018-04-01' AS TIMESTAMP) GROUP BY "r"."region_nm" LIMIT 1000
